axes: completion_pct (estimated mk2 rule yield / 273 mk1 rules)
enforcer_debt_after (count of mk2 rules with PROPOSED-only enforcer)
USER_ACK_load (count of distinct gates needing user signoff)
rollback_cost (effort to revert if migration is bad)
completion_score (1-10; weighted mean against 완성도 lens)

strategies.name: Promote migrator stub to real parser; do NOT execute migration
strategies.description: Land a robust raw_mk1_parser.hexa multi-line aware parser; migrator emits dry-run JSONL only; user manually appends rules to .raw.mk2 over time.
cons: mk2 parity stays 5.13%; no actual migration

strategies.name: Single-shot bulk migration (clone → parse → cluster → emit ALL 259 in one cycle)
strategies.description: Run the full 8-step sequence end-to-end; emit ~150-200 mk2 rules; commit in 25-rule batches; lint coverage parity check at end.
strategies.false_positive_risk: high (cluster mis-merge + cruft + enforcer debt all hit at once)
strategies.rollback_cost: moderate (revert ~10 commits via .raw.mk2 line-pruning; backup mandatory)
cons: 120+ rules with PROPOSED enforcers → mk2 becomes docs-only ledger

strategies.name: Identify all clusters, migrate cluster-batches first; 1:1 migrations second
strategies.description: Two passes: (a) cluster collapse pass yields ~25-35 mk2 rules from ~70-100 mk1 raws; review each cluster with USER ACK; then (b) 1:1 migrate remaining ~159-189 raws; each batch validated.
cons: 12 USER ACK gates is heavy load
still leaves enforcer debt for retrofit Phase

strategies.name: Migrate one domain at a time; full coverage per domain before next
strategies.description: Pick highest-leverage domain (e.g. ai-native); migrate all relevant raws (cluster + 1:1) into ai-native.NNN; verify enforcer pairing before next domain.

strategies.name: Migrate only canonical-class rules (~95%); skip locked + multi-value outliers entirely
strategies.description: Apply canonical 4-class mapping; emit ~245 mk2 rules covering live/warn/convention/deferred; defer 4 LOCKED + 13-15 multi-value outliers to a follow-up.
strategies.false_positive_risk: medium (cruft preservation hits all canonical rules)
cons: leaves the high-stakes LOCKED rules (raw 1, 87, 91, 92) for later — these are the load-bearing ones

strategies.name: Hand-review outliers first; then bulk migrate the canonical 95%
strategies.description: Phase 1: 13-15 outliers via hand-review with explicit lock_reason / multi-value modes; Phase 2: canonical 4-class bulk migrate; Phase 3: cluster collapse pass over result.
strategies.rollback_cost: very low (outliers are tiny in volume; canonical pass deterministic)
pros: outliers get full attention up front
cons: cluster pass at end risks re-merging hand-reviewed outliers

recommendation.primary_rationale: Highest 완성도 score (8.0). Cluster collapse pass is the load-bearing risk reducer (mitigates honest C3-2). Granular per-batch USER ACK gates align with raw#15 append-only ledger discipline. 12 ACK gates is heavy but tolerable given the SSOT criticality. Wall 3.5 cycles is the median of the 6 strategies.
recommendation.fallback_if_user_rejects_load: S5-canonical-only — accept higher cruft risk to halve user_ack_load.
recommendation.do_not_pick: S2-full-bulk (enforcer debt 120 + risk:high makes mk2 a docs-only ledger that defeats the clean-room rationale)

user_ack_gates_for_recommended_strategy_: G1: archive clone auth (private GitHub need-singularity/raw-archive)
G2-G12: per-cluster review (11 cluster candidates per spec §4)
G14: per-25-rule 1:1 migration batch ACK (~7-8 batches)
G15: hand-review queue manual pass (~13-15 outliers)
G16: final lint coverage parity check ACK
G17: schema lock declaration (mk2 schema-version bump if needed)

constraints.raw_9_hexa_only: all migrator tooling must be .hexa (Mac dev band)
constraints.raw_10_honest_c3: every mk2 rule needs ≥5-level honest-c3 in `why` or `note`
constraints.raw_102_monotonic: if mk1 raw is retracted in mk2, must keep retract-row preserved
constraints.raw_87_chflags: .raw stays uchg-locked; migration writes only to .raw.mk2
